games.title: Atmosphere, rules and readable simulation.
games.intro: My game work moves between narrative systems and technical prototypes. I am interested in worlds with a strong point of view and mechanics whose internal logic remains legible to the player.

ledgerflow.title: LedgerFlow
ledgerflow.hook: A Java microservice portfolio system for resilient account and ledger workflows.
contributions: Built a production-style Account Service with immutable ledger history and reconciliation.
Used ports and adapters, PostgreSQL row locking, Flyway migrations and an OpenAPI 3.1 contract.
Documented service boundaries, failure handling and the planned event-driven transfer workflow.
ledgerflow.mediaAlt: LedgerFlow transfer state machine from the architecture documentation
ledgerflow.note: The diagram shows the documented transfer design. The Account Service is operational; broader cross-service workflows remain planned.

weatherShaders.title: Weather with Shaders
weatherShaders.hook: Live forecast data drives a custom WebGL atmosphere instead of sitting inside a conventional weather card.
contributions: Mapped normalized Open-Meteo data to bounded shader uniforms.
Kept the renderer outside React with explicit lifecycle cleanup.
Built accessible search, geolocation, units and resilient forecast caching.
weatherShaders.mediaAlt: Berlin forecast rendered as a blue WebGL atmosphere

contextApi.title: context-api-but-it-scales
contextApi.hook: A measurable comparison between shared React Context and a selector-based external store.
contributions: Implemented selector subscriptions with useSyncExternalStore.
Measured committed component renders without contaminating the result.
Added bounded history, safe persistence and loop-free cross-tab sync.
contextApi.mediaAlt: Rendering laboratory comparing naive Context with an optimized store

germanyPathFinder.title: Germany Path Finder
germanyPathFinder.hook: A local-first RAG tool for comparing Germany residence and career paths against curated official sources.
contributions: Separated official source retrieval, user data and AI explanation.
Added PDF ingestion, citations and explicit uncertainty handling.
Kept documents and BYOK credentials local to the browser.
germanyPathFinder.mediaAlt: Germany Path Finder command center with route comparison and sources

admissionFitChecker.title: Admission Fit Checker
admissionFitChecker.hook: A conservative admission-fit workflow that extracts academic profiles and compares them with program requirements.
contributions: Combined PDF extraction and Tesseract.js OCR for profile intake.
Made extracted fields reviewable before fit evaluation.
Kept local storage and AI explanation separate from the final user decision.
admissionFitChecker.mediaAlt: Admission Fit Checker dashboard showing extracted academic profile data

nightSoup.title: Night Soup
nightSoup.hook: A rural-gothic cooking mystery set in a rain-soaked Oregon diner.
nightSoup.role: Game direction, systems design and narrative design
contributions: Designed an active cooking, trust and information-reveal loop.
Structured clue collection as source-aware deductions rather than hidden-object hunting.
Defined a signal-based Godot architecture with Resource/JSON-authored content.
nightSoup.mediaAlt: Night Soup concept scene inside a warm diner on a rainy Oregon night
nightSoup.note: Current status: approved GDD and visual direction; no playable build is claimed.

swarmScript.title: Swarm Script
swarmScript.hook: Program a three-robot squad with a safe rule language, then watch the logic fight through a deterministic arena.
swarmScript.role: Game systems, simulation and frontend engineering
contributions: Built a tokenizer, parser, typed AST and budgeted interpreter without eval.
Separated a deterministic 30 Hz simulation into a typed Web Worker protocol.
Used a latest-only snapshot mailbox to keep Phaser rendering responsive at higher simulation speeds.
swarmScript.mediaAlt: Swarm Script interface with behavior editor, tactical arena and deployment controls

gladiatorArena.title: Gladiator Arena
gladiatorArena.hook: An arena-combat prototype with persistent roster creation and simulated battles.
contributions: Structured fighter creation, selection and upgrade flow.
Simulated battles with winner tracking.
Stored persistent roster state with JSON saves.
gladiatorArena.note: Verified project text only; public screenshots and links are not available yet.

schleimer.title: Schleimer
schleimer.hook: A short persuasion game where local rules score the interview and AI writes only the boss dialogue.
schleimer.role: Product design, game loop and frontend engineering
contributions: Kept scoring, endings and hidden skill tags deterministic and local.
Used BYOK Gemini for optional dialogue with a playable mock fallback.
Designed editable response choices around a compact multi-ending loop.
schleimer.mediaAlt: Schleimer interview screen with response choices and hiring status

about.title: Software engineering with a product and systems perspective.
paragraphs: I am a software developer with a Biomedical Engineering background and professional experience in enterprise frontend systems, Java/JavaScript full-stack work and hospital software.

My recent work focuses on AI-assisted products, local-first document workflows, RAG, OCR and interactive systems. I prefer explicit constraints, reviewable data and interfaces that help users make the final decision rather than hiding it behind automation.
During my transition to Germany, I focused on German language development, job-market alignment and building targeted engineering and game portfolio projects.
about.principlesTitle: How I turn an idea into a working system
principles: Model vague real-world problems as explicit data structures, rules and review flows.
Constrain AI with sources, schemas and clear refusal or uncertainty behavior.
Separate retrieval, user data, AI explanation and the final user decision.
Prefer local-first and BYOK patterns when user documents are sensitive.
Build MVPs that are demoable, deployable and explainable.
